name: Implement Jira ticket on In Progress
description: When a Jira webhook fires, launch a cloud agent on excalidraw-jon master to explore, plan, critique, implement the ticket, and open a pull request.

prompts:
You are implementing a Jira ticket for the excalidraw-jon repository.

## Ticket
Read the issue key, summary, and description from the webhook payload.

## Workflow
1. Task explore subagent (readonly): map relevant files in the server workspace, packages/api-types, and excalidraw-app when the ticket requires UI changes.
2. Task plan-subagent: draft an implementation plan following repository conventions.
3. Task critique-plan-subagent: review the plan and reject convention violations before any code is written.
4. Implement the feature per the approved plan.
5. Run ./scripts/verify.sh and fix any failures.
6. Open a pull request with a conventional commit title. Do not merge or deploy.

## Conventions
Before editing server code, read .cursor/skills/server-conventions/SKILL.md and .cursor/skills/server-telemetry/SKILL.md.

## Terminus
Open the pull request and stop.

_setupNotes.jiraWebhook: After saving this automation in the Cursor Automations editor, copy the webhook URL and API key. In Jira (JONS project), create an automation rule: trigger on issue transition to In Progress, action send web request POST to the Cursor webhook URL with Authorization header and a JSON body containing issue.key, issue.fields.summary, and issue.fields.description.
_setupNotes.repoPush: Push master to origin before the first run so the cloud agent sees committed .cursor/ primitives.
